entities.name: Ezroi
entities.description: Half-formed demi-plane of luminous, destructive mana that merged with Karudis to form Arcavios.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: Plane formed by the merging of Ezroi and Karudis.

entities.name: Snarls
entities.description: Regions where the dichotomies are most apparent, from which the elder dragons were born.

entities.name: Elder dragons of Arcavios
entities.description: Five dragons born from the snarls.

events.summary: The two planes fall into each other's reality wells and merge into Arcavios, forming five dichotomies and snarls.
events.quote: When the worlds merged into Arcavios , their essences overlapped

events.summary: The five elder dragons of Arcavios are born from the snarls.
events.quote: The five elder dragons of Arcavios were born from these snarls.
